title: Errors carry a code
statement: An error MUST carry a code.

title: Tests name what they check
statement: A test MUST name what it checks.

title: Names are nouns
statement: A module's name SHOULD be a noun.

title: Dates are UTC
statement: A stored date MUST be UTC, as STX-STD-CODE-R05 says of itself.

title: Money is in cents
statement: An amount MUST be held in cents.
